1.w: A song of ascents; by David. I was glad because they said to me, “We will go to the Lord ’s temple.”

2.w: Our feet are standing inside your gates, O Jerusalem.

3.w: Jerusalem is a city designed to accommodate an assembly.

4.w: The tribes go up there, the tribes of the Lord , where it is required that Israel give thanks to the name of the Lord .

5.w: Indeed, the leaders sit there on thrones and make legal decisions, on the thrones of the house of David.

6.w: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. May those who love her prosper.

7.w: May there be peace inside your defenses and prosperity inside your fortresses.

8.w: For the sake of my brothers and my neighbors I will say, “May there be peace in you.”

9.w: For the sake of the temple of the Lord our God I will pray for you to prosper.
